name: FOS Capital Limited
summary: FOS Capital Limited makes and distributes lighting in Australia and New Zealand through its subsidiaries, from commercial luminaires and outdoor fittings to linear extruded and architectural products. Its brands include JSB Lighting, FORMA Lighting, VEKTA PROFILES, FREND Lighting and others. Founded in 2019 and based in Richmond, it is owned by SKM Investment Group Pty Ltd.
